title: Quick check: Event Propagation

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Event Propagation”?
options: The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
Bubbling should connect an interaction to a handler without doing the action during render.
The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
questions.answer_key: Bubbling should connect an interaction to a handler without doing the action during render.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Event Propagation: Bubbling should connect an interaction to a handler without doing the action during render.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Bubbling?
options: Use a semantic interactive element and pass a handler function rather than calling it during render.
Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
questions.answer_key: Use a semantic interactive element and pass a handler function rather than calling it during render.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Event Propagation: Use a semantic interactive element and pass a handler function rather than calling it during render.

questions.prompt: What should you verify before considering “Event Propagation” complete?
options: Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
Assume a client-side check proves that a remote service accepted the change.
Rely only on a screenshot of the happy path and never repeat the test.
Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Event Propagation: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
